title: should show stream-not-found message when SQL query names a missing stream
verifies: a SQL query naming a missing stream renders the Stream "…" does not exist message and the generic empty state does not shadow it

title: should clear the message and select the stream when the query names an existing stream
verifies: replacing the query with an existing stream clears the message and selects the stream

title: should dismiss the message when the query is cleared
verifies: emptying the editor dismisses the message and restores the generic empty state

title: should clear the message when a stream is selected in the sidebar
verifies: selecting a stream in the sidebar clears the message
